verdicts.reason: S009 states the Feeder Protection Relay produces the Relay Diagnostic Note, and S109 says the Protection Relay Engineer uses that same note during fault analysis.

S006 identifies the Bay Automation Controller as producing a Bay Status Digest, and S139's shorter reference to the status digest is used by the Station Supervisory Control System with no competing digest identified.
S048 says the Station Supervisory Control System produces the Alarm Acknowledgement Slip, and S152 says the Control Room Operator uses the acknowledgement slip for the alarm response record.
S044 states the Satellite Time Receiver produces the Clock Drift Snapshot, and S140 explicitly says the Sequence Event Archive receives the Clock Drift Snapshot.
S089 says the Substation Field Crew completes and sends the Breaker Inspection Tag, and S179 says the Bay Automation Controller uses the inspection tag.
S057 states the Engineering Workstation produces the Settings Review Receipt, and S206 says the Maintenance Remote Terminal uses the review receipt, with no other review receipt introduced.
S141 says the Switching Desk Coordinator produces the Isolation Boundary Card, and S233 says the Substation Field Crew uses that card to verify the approved work boundary.
S120 states the Station DC System produces a Battery Load Test Record, and S207 says the Bay Automation Controller uses the load test record.
S142 identifies the Station Gateway as producing the Protocol Retry Summary, and S208 says the Station Supervisory Control System receives that summary.
S168 states the Control Room Operator produces the Clearance Handoff Memo, and S235 says the Switching Desk Coordinator receives that memo.
S004 assigns the project codename Juniper to the Bay Automation Controller, and S121 uses Juniper consistently for that entity.
S026 names the Station Supervisory Control System Glasswing, and S156 uses Glasswing in a role matching that system.
S050 identifies Tandem as the Feeder Protection Relay, and S186 describes Tandem performing feeder relay protection functions.
S074 states the Substation Field Crew is known operationally as Cinder, and S209 uses Cinder for field-work boundary verification.
S051 identifies Larkspur as the Protection Relay Engineer, and S143 uses Larkspur for protection coordination review.
S037 names the Satellite Time Receiver Bluefin, and S144 uses Bluefin as the provider of the station time reference.
S099 identifies Orchard as the Sequence Event Archive, and S210 uses Orchard for retaining event information.
S123 identifies Keystone as the Switching Desk Coordinator, and S236 uses Keystone for switching-authority coordination duties.
S130 explicitly names the North Bay Controller as the controller blocking the close command, not the South Bay Controller.
S161 explicitly concerns the Transformer Protection Panel and transformer protection operation, not the North Protection Panel.
